title: Charlie and the Great Glass Elevator
author: Roald Dahl
short_summary: Charlie Bucket, his grandfather Joe, and Willy Wonka soar into space in Wonka's Great Glass Elevator after it shoots straight through the roof of the chocolate factory. They dock with an orbiting Space Hotel and must survive a dangerous encounter with shape-shifting alien Vermicious Knids before returning safely to Earth. Back at the factory, a batch of age-reversing Wonka-Vite candy causes new chaos when it is used incorrectly.
extended_summary:
Just after Charlie wins Willy Wonka's chocolate factory, he, his grandfather Joe, Mr. Wonka, and the rest of the Bucket family are riding home in the fantastical Great Glass Elevator when Mr. Wonka presses the wrong button and the elevator blasts straight up through the factory roof and into outer space. There they discover a brand-new American Space Hotel being launched into orbit, empty and waiting for its official opening — and the glass elevator docks right alongside it. Before long, the group finds themselves facing off against terrifying, shape-shifting alien creatures called Vermicious Knids, who threaten to destroy the hotel and everyone aboard.

After a tense escape from the Knids and a safe return to the chocolate factory, the story is not yet finished — Mr. Wonka has invented Wonka-Vite, a candy that makes a person younger, and its dangerous opposite, Vita-Wonk, which makes a person older. When Charlie's grandparents secretly take far too many Wonka-Vite pills, they shrink into babies and nearly vanish into nothingness, forcing Mr. Wonka and Charlie to use Vita-Wonk carefully to bring them back to the right age. The adventure highlights Mr. Wonka's endless, sometimes reckless, inventiveness and Charlie's steady courage and quick thinking in the face of danger.
